title: What founders ask before they book a call

items.a: You do. Full ownership of the code and intellectual property transfers on final payment. We keep only the right to say we built it.
A deposit books your start date. After that, you pay per milestone once it ships and you sign it off. The fixed price is in the contract, so every invoice matches finished work.
The deadline is in the contract, and you pay per finished milestone. If we're late, you haven't paid for that milestone yet.
Anything outside the agreed scope. We price it in writing before we build it, so the deadline you signed off stays the same.
Your code is in your own accounts, with documentation and a set period of free fixes. To keep shipping, the Build Partner Retainer costs from €4k a month and you can cancel anytime.

The studio is two founders working with AI agents. The agents do the engineering, inside human-owned architecture, code review and security gates. Senior judgment decides what to build, how it is architected and secured, and what is ready to ship.

items.q: Where can I see your work?
items.a: We show our own products first. Bloop, an AI events concierge, is in build and piloting in Bologna. Washiiba, a laundry marketplace on web and mobile from one codebase, is built end to end. Kerf is a case study on public LiDAR data from June 2021. One run covered 345 spans on 28.4 km of overhead line and 829.5 million LiDAR points in 83 seconds on one server. Kerf is not yet validated in the field and has no paying customer. It has its own site, projectkerf.com. Recovery Room, a booking app, is a pilot live at a gym in Cagliari.

items.q: What happens after I book a call?
items.a: First, a free 25-minute call. Within 2 business days you get a written fixed-price proposal. If it fits, you pay the deposit, we agree a start date, and the build begins.
